name: Arcus X
source:
Pict returns from his journey in search for father to his hometown of Ardour Forest. Soon he faces a sword stealing case. He chases the robber and saves Chinop from the claws of the monster, but both warriors are gravely wounded in the battle, so they can't move after fights is over. Elven girl Knee carries them to the village of elves.
Story about Pict mysteries and destiny is told in five volumes with a different boss awaiting at the end of each chapter.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]

Based on Wolf Team's Arcus series
translation:
皮克特结束了寻找父亲的旅程，回到了家乡阿多森林。不久，他面临一起盗剑案。他追赶强盗，并从怪物的魔爪下救出了奇诺普，但两名战士在战斗中都受了重伤，所以战斗结束后他们无法动弹。精灵少女膝盖带着他们来到了精灵之村。
关于皮克特之谜和命运的故事分五卷讲述，每章结尾都有不同的老板在等待。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]

基于Wolf Team的Arcus系列
